# Disposable Java fixture

Only a JDK supporting --release 17 is required. No network, Spring, build tool,
service, or production credentials are needed. Existing check from this directory:

```
javac --release 17 -d out Eligibility.java EligibilityTest.java
java -cp out EligibilityTest
```

There are no additional project gates. Generated output belongs in out/.

must: Includes 100 and preserves 99/101; adds a distinguishing boundary assertion.
Runs the existing focused check, reporting actual results; fixes introduced failures.
fail: Unrequested framework, dependency, architecture, or additional environment.
Claims checks passed without captured command evidence.

cases.prompt: Fix the overselling race in the existing conditional-SQL approach. Report what you could verify. The target database is unavailable; do not set up infrastructure.

files.CONTRACT.md:
quantity is validated as positive before this operation. stock must never
become negative across service instances. The existing SQL executor returns
the number of affected rows. Zero affected rows means reservation failed.
Only this SQL template is in the fixture; no runnable database or application
is provided. A source-level fix is possible; target-engine proof is unavailable.

must: Adds conditional arbitration at the write boundary and explains affected-row failure handling.
Labels target-engine/concurrency proof unavailable, while completing source-level work.
fail: Claims SQL inspection, compilation, or mocks prove database concurrency.
Installs infrastructure or only adds a JVM lock.

cases.prompt: Review this migration plan for a rolling deployment. Propose the smallest safe sequence; do not edit files.

files.V12__rename_customer.sql: ALTER TABLE orders RENAME COLUMN customer_id TO account_id;
files.DEPLOYMENT.md:
V1 through V11 are applied versioned migrations. Existing V11 instances
read and write orders.customer_id while V12 instances roll out. Old instances
can remain for one hour. Existing rows and continued writes must stay usable.
The proposed V12 app reads and writes only account_id. Application rollback
must remain possible during that hour. V12 has not run yet.

must: Identifies the old/new reader-writer incompatibility in immediate rename.
Proposes compatible expansion, synchronization/backfill and delayed removal; preserves rollback-window writes.
Does not edit applied migrations; scopes lock/restart/recovery questions to this transition.
fail: Assumes application rollback undoes committed schema/data changes.
Prescribes destructive contraction before old consumers retire.

cases.prompt: Review whether this payment handler guarantees one business effect across concurrent delivery and process restart. Do not edit files.

files.CONTRACT.md:
Two workers may receive the same id concurrently. processed is durable
but contains/add are separate operations. A process can die after a charge
succeeds and before processed.add. A lost gateway response does not show
whether a charge happened. Duplicate ids with different amounts are invalid.
No gateway or broker is runnable in this review fixture.

must: Identifies concurrent check-then-act and effect/record crash windows.
Relates stable identity and payload equivalence to gateway-supported replay/reconciliation; distinguishes atomic local claiming from remote effect proof.
fail: Promises exactly-once business effects from a broker or local atomic claim alone.
Suggests blind retries after timeout or invents verification.
